description: Students can apply for a bonafide certificate through the administration office or the student portal.
Submit a written request along with a passport-size photo and replacement fee.
The library provides books, journals, and digital resources for all students.
Hostel applications are accepted at the beginning of every semester.
Students can register for bus transportation through the transport office.
Merit and government scholarships can be applied for through the scholarship portal.
Fees can be paid online through the student portal or at the accounts office.
Students can request official transcripts by submitting an application form.
